imageOnlyRule: A registry model is image-only, and excluded from this manifest, when its category field is exactly "Image". Every other category is text-capable and needs a saved reply for each of the eight rendering-harness prompts. supports_image_generation is not consulted. output_modalities is not a registry field; admin add copies an image output modality into category "Image".
